description: We are Quark & Co.—a squad of science enthusiasts who believe that every major discovery starts with the smallest particle of curiosity. Powered by logic, experimentation, and seamless teamwork, we are ready to tackle any scientific challenge!
summary:
The Last Whisper: Abandoned But Not Forgotten follows an astronaut named Aira and her small robot companion, Luna, on a rescue mission to preserve ancient ecological secrets on Mars.   
BETHIA 1.jpg
+ 2
The Discovery (Page 1): While testing the Apollo 11 laser mirror on the Moon, Aira and Luna detect an unusual energy reflection. Meanwhile, on Mars, an old rover uncovers hidden Voyager data and ancient ecological records ("The Whispering Stones"), just as a massive global dust storm threatens to bury the site forever. Warned by a holographic entity called The Archivist, Aira and Luna launch an immediate rescue mission to Mars.   

The Rescue (Page 2): Battling fierce winds and disrupted navigation systems, Aira and Luna land on Mars and locate the struggling rover inside a crater. Working together, they synchronize their technology with the rover to merge and save the fragmented data. The restored projection reveals that Mars once had a thriving biosphere—holding crucial ecological answers for the future.   

Preserving the Legacy (Page 3): Aira extracts the ancient biosphere data and thanks the Mars rover for its service. She and Luna fly back to the Moon, storing the recovered knowledge inside the Star Memory Archive so future generations of explorers can learn from it and ensure the history of space exploration is never forgotten.
